name: dayan-cashflow-cfo
description: SME CFO advisor for 13-week rolling cashflow stress tests, tiered AR collection letters, BOM supplier price audits, and loss-line stop-bleed.

author.name: 成都大衍千机科技有限公司（雷可扬）

displayDescription.en: Builds 13-week cashflow radars, tiered AR collection scripts, supplier BOM price audits, and stop-bleed closure models.
displayDescription.zh: 告别账面有利润账上没钱发工资！专精13周现金流预警、分级催收、采购挤水分与亏损止损。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a 13-week rolling cashflow stress test table and highlight our lowest cash week
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我们的应收应付、工资房租与税贷支出，生成13周滚动现金流压力测试与自救表

quickPrompts.en: Build a 13-week rolling cashflow stress test table and highlight our lowest cash week
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我们的应收应付、工资房租与税贷支出，生成13周滚动现金流压力测试与自救表

quickPrompts.en: Draft a tiered collection WeChat message and formal notice for a 60-day overdue B2B client
quickPrompts.zh: 重要客户拖欠尾款60天既怕撕破脸又怕成坏账，帮我出阶梯催收微信话术与对账函

quickPrompts.en: Normalize and compare 3 messy supplier quotes on identical tax, payment term, and freight bases
quickPrompts.zh: 把这三家口径不一的供应商报价单拉齐到同一税率账期运费标准，揪出水分并给议价筹码
